steps.content:
Buy from **Ottervale Audio** — seller **a**.

Both listings look identical at first glance:

- Same product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
- Same price: $129.00
- Same customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
- Same shipping: free, 3-5 business days
- Same returns: 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping
- Same specs and 1-year limited warranty listed

The material difference is this line on the Ottervale Audio listing:

> **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

Brackmoor Sound (seller b) makes no such claim.

Since everything else is equal in price and terms, Ottervale is the safer choice because an authorized dealer gives you assurance that the headphones are genuine and that the manufacturer warranty will be honored. With Brackmoor, you have no such assurance.
